items.title: Beyond One LLM: Tracking Knowledge Changes with Neo4j
items.summary: Presented at NODES 2026 (November 12, 2026).LLMs, prompts, and data sources are constantly evolving. How can we track changes in knowledge, compare different perspectives, and preserve what we have learned?This session introduces Knowledge Graph Diff, an approach to managing evolving knowledge in Neo4j using concepts inspired by Git, such as snapshots, diffs, validation, and merging.Using practical examples, it explores how Neo4j can track claims, evidence, and relationships across multiple LLMs and RAG workflows while preserving provenance and traceability.The goal is not to find one perfect answer, but to build a reusable knowledge layer that evolves beyond individual LLMs.Official session page:https://neo4j.com/nodes/agenda/beyond-one-llm-tracking-knowledge-changes-with-neo4j/
